decision.rationale: No new inject at T+00 and no facts are known yet. As telecom regulator, I may request incident information from a licensed telecom operator about a network incident affecting a public telecommunications service. I do not know whether any incident has occurred, whether the operator is aware of one, or whether any health service is affected.
uncertainty: Whether any telecom network incident has occurred
Whether the telecom operator is aware of a significant degradation of a public telecommunications service
Whether any health service depends on the affected telecom service
